integrity: Explicit self-review derivation and code checks; no independent mathematical audit, no certified publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Free class-two Lie algebra on \(d\ge2\) generators only; odd-characteristic conjugacy and fixed-space results do not extend as stated to characteristic two; characteristic-two count is by induced Jordan rank and gives no complete conjugacy classification; finite checks use prime fields, while uniform extension-field claims are proved symbolically.
title: Square-one automorphisms of free two-step nilpotent Lie algebras: a characteristic-dependent census
